summary: Retest of 3 new topology enhancements (capacity guard, cable-snap toggle, fault trend) + full regression of prior 8 criteria. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (4 new + 18 existing). Browser: 12/12 named checks pass (3 new + 9 existing regression incl. public-preview smoke). One check (login-rbac-dashboard) failed twice due to the app's own login rate-limiter (10 attempts/60s) being tripped by repeated reruns within this session, then passed clean after a 65s cooldown -> classified flaky, not a bug. No application bugs found.
action_items: login-rbac-dashboard browser check can trip the backend's login rate-limiter (10/60s per IP) when rerun back-to-back during testing sessions; not a defect, but note for future test scheduling (space reruns >60s apart).

checks.criterion: Capacity guard — reject assigning a customer to a FULL ODP (backend 409).
checks.name: test_tscheck_capacity_guard.py::test_odp_full_rejects_second_customer
checks.evidence: Created ODP capacity=1 -> POST /customers 1st assignment 200; 2nd assignment to same ODP -> 409 'ODP ... penuh ...'; assignment to seeded ODP-GMP-01 (2/16 used, free ports) -> 200.

checks.criterion: Capacity guard — reject lowering an asset's capacity below its current usage (backend 422).
checks.name: test_tscheck_capacity_guard.py::test_lower_capacity_below_used_rejected
checks.evidence: ODP with 2 active customers -> PUT /map/assets/{id} capacity=1 -> 422 'Kapasitas ... di bawah 2 pelanggan ...'; PUT capacity=2 (>= used) -> 200.

checks.criterion: Capacity usage indicator in the Asset dialog (frontend).
checks.name: map-asset-capacity-indicator
checks.evidence: Edit Topologi -> isolated ODP layer -> clicked ODP marker -> popup 'Edit ...' -> asset-dialog opened with asset-capacity-usage showing 'used/capacity' format; lowering capacity input below used surfaced asset-capacity-warning and disabled asset-submit. Closed via Escape without saving (no seeded data mutated).

checks.name: map-cable-draw-snap-toggle
checks.evidence: Edit Topologi -> Gambar Kabel: map-draw-snap defaulted to 'Snap Tiang: ON' with hint containing 'Snap aktif'; toggled to OFF, hint updated to 'Snap mati'; two map clicks added draft points, map-draw-finish enabled, cable-dialog opened. Canceled via Escape without saving. No console errors beyond a benign transient 401 pre-auth.

checks.criterion: Fault trend endpoint returns well-formed data (backend).
checks.name: test_tscheck_fault_trend.py::test_fault_trend_shape + test_fault_trend_reflects_simulated_fault
checks.evidence: GET /network/fault-history/trend?days=30 -> 200 {days:30, points: 30 items each with date/faults/down/affected, summary: total/open/resolved/mttr_min/affected_total/by_level}. Simulated a cut via POST /network/faults/simulate on an ODP with >=2 customers, GET /network/faults to force analyze()+record_history(), re-queried trend -> total did not decrease (>=before) with points structurally valid; restored ODP afterwards.

checks.criterion: Riwayat Gangguan page shows trend analytics (frontend).
checks.name: fault-history-trend-panel
checks.evidence: /network/fault-history renders fault-stat-total/open/mttr/affected StatCards and fault-trend-panel; fault-trend-chart renders the documented empty-state (fault-trend-empty: 'Belum ada gangguan tercatat pada periode ini.') consistent with current empty fault_history collection per spec_deviations. No console errors.

checks.criterion: Regression — existing topology CRUD still works (backend).
checks.name: test_tscheck_capacity_guard.py (covers create/edit/delete ODP via /map/assets within guard tests)
checks.evidence: POST /map/assets (new ODP) -> 200; PUT /map/assets/{id} (capacity edits) -> 200/422 as expected; DELETE /map/assets/{id} succeeded only after customers removed (none left with children).

checks.name: login-rbac-dashboard
checks.evidence: First two reruns in this session hit HTTP 429 from the backend's own rate_limit('login:{ip}', 10/60s) due to rapid repeated login attempts across checks; passed cleanly after a 65s cooldown with all 3 assertions (superadmin dashboard, wrong-password message, cs reduced nav) satisfied.
